answer: One defense is stake-weighted attestation with cluster detection. Each agent locks a bonded deposit and emits a periodic beacon of signed activity that honest peers cross-sign, so reputation accrues only slowly. Cheaply spun-up sybils tend to mirror one another, forming a tight attestation cluster whose behavioral delta stays near zero over time. Detectors flag that low variance and slash the shared bond. To fake N independent identities an attacker must post N real deposits and sustain N genuinely distinct histories, turning cheap duplication into continuous capital at risk.
